payload.text: Before the 0.1.10 cut, on vc's word that the tip is final: the kovacs gates (check all, test all, build and doctor) and, in the same heavy slot, a scratch-HOME bin/devbin install with a listing of the opt tree and its manifest, showing LICENSE in the tree and named in the manifest (ISSUE:0009: no run has yet laid out an installed tree with the files entry back). The final tip is cc's ISSUE:0008 unit plus cc's follow-up unit (the incoming-login check and items 6 and 7). When vc says it is final, dc asks devbin-vc for the slot (the Desk's hold is devbin-vc's and hv's to lift) and announces the run to kovacs-sysadm. The cut carries ISSUE:0008 whole, ISSUE:0009 and ic's Herdr fix, and ships first thing (hv's decision 12, through vc).
